So now WE are closing the Strait. This is - just in case you were wondering - as dumb as it sounds. 

It’s a classic case of one tragic mistake begetting another because of out of control hubris and pride.


Elizabeth Hagedorn (@ElizHagedorn)

To summarize: 
• US Navy will blockade Strait of Hormuz
• Will interdict vessels that paid Iran a toll 
• Will destroy mines laid by Iran 
• "Other countries" will be involved in blockade
• "The Blockade will begin shortly."







— https://nitter.net/Eli

Between the war and tariffs and general incompetence, Trump is deliberately ruining the economy.


The Wall Street Journal (@WSJ)

Breaking: Inflation accelerated to 3.3% in March, the hottest reading in two years on.wsj.com/423QRf7



— https://nitter.net/WSJ/status/2042582187929645303#m

3 ships. 

The Strait is not open.


Annmarie Hordern (@annmarie)

“We have seen an uptick of traffic in the strait today,” says Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt.

According to ship-tracking data compiled by Bloomberg just three ships were observed leaving the region on Wednesday. 
bloomberg.com/news/articles/…




— https://nitter.net/annmarie/status/2041939642656620565#m

Israel must stop these attacks. No matter how incompetently negotiated this ceasefire was, we should all want it hold. But that means all parties to this regional war - the U.S., Iran, Israel, and Iran's proxies - must stand down.


Joyce Karam (@Joyce_Karam)

Horrifying scenes from Beirut #Lebanon today. Nearly 100 Israeli airstrikes in less than 10 minutes, in broad daylight, with rush hour traffic heard in background. At least 89 killed…

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Joyce_Karam/status/

If you've paid any attention to what I've said for weeks, you know I want the war to end immediately. So of course I'm glad if this ceasefire holds.

That's not inconsistent with pointing out that we are worse off now than before the war started and that's it bad if Iran controls the Strait. I've been 100% clear there is no military means to reopen the Strait and the only way forward is for Trump to stop the war. 

I think it's important to point out how ham handed this entire endeavor has been

Hard to believe that a rushed agreement made under the threat of civilization annihilation doesn't seem to be holding together for more than 24 hours.


Iran News 24 (@IRanMediaco)

BREAKING: Iranian military source: 

"No oil tanker or ship belonging to the enemies will pass through the Strait of Hormuz before 'Israel' commits to a ceasefire in Lebanon"



— https://nitter.net/IRanMediaco/status/2041844021493117217#m
I guess you can't blame Trump since there really isn't any evidence or history to contradict Bibi's rosy assessments of how easy a U.S-led war in the Middle East would be.

This is an account close to the Iranian leadership. We are now seeing the shape of why Iran agreed so enthusiastically to this "ceasefire". 

They will control and toll the Strait for the first time. They keep their nuclear program. They keep their missiles. 

What a disaster.


هنر جنگ (@dolfiniran)

۰۴:۳۶/ ۱۹ فروردین
طی ‘توقف آتش’ دو هفته ای، تنها حدود ۱۰ تا ۱۵ کشتی با موافقت ایران، در هماهنگی با نیروی دریایی سپاه و پس از پرداخت عوارض از تنگه هرمز رد خواهند شد و امریکا متعهد است تمام اموال بلو
Big win in Wisconsin. Was proud to endorse and support another great Chris.

No President in control of his senses would publicly promise to eradicate an entire civilization.

That's why I agree with Republicans who have put the 25th Amendment on the table. Trump seems to be taking us on a path to mass war crimes. That's a path we cannot accept.

Video

Even if Iran reopens the Strait, how is that a "good outcome"? The region is on fire. The global economy is going to take a year or more to recover. An anti-American regime is in power and emboldened. Iran still has their missiles and nuclear program. That's "good"?


Brett McGurk (@brett_mcgurk)

This sets a precondition—

“The Islamic Republic of Iran agreeing to the complete, immediate, and safe reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.”

If met, that’s a good outcome.





— https://nitter.net/bret

Iran says the U.S. has agreed to their 10 point plan, which gives them control of the Strait, lets them keep their nuclear program and also their missiles, and drops sanctions against Iran.

If this isn't true - and let's hope it's not - it is proof that there is indeed no deal.


Faytuks News (@Faytuks)

Iran's Supreme National Security Council calls this a "crushing defeat" for the US, saying that they've been forced to accept their 10-point plan.

Iran claims the US has agreed to continued Ir

It appears Trump just agreed to give Iran control of the Strait of Hormuz, a history-changing win for Iran.

The level of incompetence is both stunning and heartbreaking.

What on earth is happening?
I will be on @CNN in a few minutes to talk about our completely unhinged President and a war that is spiraling fast out of control.

Also Congress could just vote to stop him. Your party could simply choose to not have America commit war crimes.


Former Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene🇺🇸 (@FmrRepMTG)

25TH AMENDMENT!!!
Not a single bomb has dropped on America. We cannot kill an entire civilization. 
This is evil and madness.





— https://nitter.net/FmrRepMTG/status/2041499550012084690#m
Feels like as the Iran War spirals out of control and DHS remains shut down, Republican leaders in Congress should call us back into session. But they won’t.
